newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Michigan raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Michigan raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said on Wednesday it raised its intermediate six-month rating on First Michigan Bank Corp to outperformer from market performer.

--"The recent advance in bank stocks and the market as a whole has left First Michigan behind," EVEREN noted in a report. "After yesterday's strong showing by the sector, investors wil likely search for opportunities in the less well-known names."
--EVEREN said it believes First Michigan's stock ought to track back to its average premium to the group of 30 percent.
